# Vendored References

This directory contains upstream reference repositories used to build MMO's cross-agent integration layer.

## Sources

- `openai-apps-sdk-examples/`
  - Source: `https://github.com/openai/openai-apps-sdk-examples`
  - Purpose: official OpenAI Apps SDK examples for ChatGPT app/widget patterns over MCP.

- `anthropic-skills/`
  - Source: `https://github.com/anthropics/skills`
  - Purpose: official Anthropic reusable Agent Skills examples and packaging conventions.

## Policy

These directories are vendored references. Keep their upstream license files intact. MMO product code should live under `apps/`, `packages/`, `skills/`, `openai/`, `anthropic/`, and `docs/`.
